data.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew Elisheba, meaning 'God is my oath' or 'God's promise'. In the Bible, Elisheba was a woman of great faith who provided hospitality to the prophet Samuel. The name Isabelita carries the meaning “God's promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isabelita usually hope their child will grow to embody god's promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
